verdict.rationale: The evidence shows DeepInfra hosts LLMs behind an OpenAI-compatible chat API, so users can send natural-language prompts to models. Nothing shows the platform itself can be operated through natural-language commands, such as deploying models, managing instances or GPU clusters, or configuring service tiers. Serving chat models is adjacent to this story and does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
